name: ANDV Gn-Gc Subunit Vaccine
notes: First high-resolution 3D maps of Andes virus Gn-Gc; structure-based vaccine design

name: Hantavirus DNA Vaccine (pWRG/AND-M)
status: Completed Phase 1; >80% seroconversion; paused for funding
notes: Historically most advanced hantavirus vaccine candidate; requires electroporation delivery

name: Hantavax (Inactivated HTNV/SEOV)
status: Licensed in South Korea since 1990; limited efficacy data
notes: Only commercially available hantavirus vaccine; limited to HFRS; uncertain long-term efficacy

name: Anti-ANDV Neutralizing mAb Panel
status: Collaboration announced May 2026; scalable production platform
notes: Using C1 protein production platform for rapid mAb manufacturing at scale

name: ANDV/SNV Cross-Reactive mAbs
status: B-cell and T-cell immune response characterization ongoing
notes: Aims for pan-New World hantavirus broadly neutralizing antibodies

name: Favipiravir (T-705)
status: Inhibits ANDV replication in human cells and organoids in vitro
notes: Approved for influenza in Japan; repurposing candidate; oral administration

name: Ribavirin
status: Weak evidence for New World hantaviruses; used primarily for HFRS
notes: Only antiviral with clinical use history for hantavirus; efficacy debated

name: mRNA-ANDV-Spike
status: Animal studies ongoing; leveraging COVID-era mRNA platforms
notes: mRNA technology transfer from SARS-CoV-2 vaccine programs

name: rVSV-ANDV
status: Protective in hamster models; single-dose regimen
notes: Similar platform to Merck's Ebola vaccine (Ervebo); strong preclinical data

name: Convalescent Plasma Therapy
status: Used in MV Hondius outbreak (2026); anecdotal benefit reports
notes: Open-label trial in Chile showed potential mortality reduction; logistics challenging

name: VLP-Hantavirus (Virus-Like Particle)
status: Collaboration announced May 2026 for rapid development
notes: VLP platform for enhanced immunogenicity without live virus

name: Rapid Point-of-Care ANDV Test
status: Deployed during MV Hondius outbreak for rapid screening
notes: 15-minute result; critical for early diagnosis in field settings

name: ECMO Protocol for HCPS
status: Established; survival benefit demonstrated in critical HPS
notes: VA-ECMO preferred; early initiation (<24h of shock) associated with improved survival

name: Lactimidomycin Analogs
status: In vitro activity against multiple hantavirus strains
notes: Novel mechanism of action; broad-spectrum potential

name: ChAdOx-ANDV
status: ISARIC CCP framework activated post-MV Hondius; accelerated development
notes: Same ChAdOx platform as AstraZeneca COVID vaccine; rapid deployment capability
